subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the one-way device-identity cutover in which Doctor retires `identity/device.json`, mixed-version processes must not share the state directory, and downgrade to a JSON-only binary is unsupported?
rationale: This is an intentional persistent-state and operational compatibility contract; code review can verify implementation mechanics but cannot decide the supported upgrade and rollback policy.

options.title: Accept after regression repair
options.body: Fix the App Group legacy-source selection and accept the documented Doctor-managed one-way migration and coordinated-version requirement.

options.title: Defer the cutover
options.body: Keep JSON identity as the supported persistence path until maintainers choose a rollback or mixed-version compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Accept after regression repair
recommendation.body: Fix the App Group legacy-source selection and accept the documented Doctor-managed one-way migration and coordinated-version requirement.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the current migration series and can provide the most direct implementation and contract context for an owner decision.
